scope: Frozen 64-query complete-chain development pilot on the same18 audited evaluation parents. Same MALA/force-rotation background, two shared per-parent-step seeds, and acceptance variate independent of candidate construction. Six methods include strong single-edit/physical controls and simple learned radial coupling. Query-budget endpoints are not equilibrium samples. Connectivity and geometric exploration are not certified basins. Includes inference time and marginal label costs, not a fully charged cold-start or final-test advantage.
uncertainty: Descriptive parent bootstrap within six fixed compositions, keeping both replicas together, all15 pairwise method comparisons shown, no multiplicity correction or final-test claim.
